summary: Azilsartan Medoxomil carries the FDA's strongest warning because it can cause injury or death to an unborn baby, so it must be stopped as soon as pregnancy is detected [3][6]. The drug label also warns to fix low salt or body fluid levels before use and to check for worsening kidney function in patients who already have kidney issues [6]. Additionally, a small computer model—not tests done on people—gave the drug a high risk score of 79 for the liver and a low risk score of 40 for the heart [M].
